source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of visualization types (PDF 146).

blocks.text: Mukhtalif visualizations mukhtalif maqasid ke liye hain: bar charts, line graphs, histograms, scatterplots aur boxplots.

blocks.alt: Chhe hisse: Class A aur Class B ke scores ka grouped bar chart, rozana kamai ka line graph jo 500 se 1,300 rupay tak barhta hai, das exam scores ka histogram 50s se 90s ke khanon mein ginti 1, 2, 2, 3, 2, parhai ke ghanton banam marks ka scatterplot dashed best-fit line ke saath, Class A aur Class B ke boxplots, aur chart banane ke spreadsheet qadam.
blocks.caption: Is chapter ke data se paanch qism ke charts (topics 5.5 aur 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bars qismon ka muwazna karte hain, yahan do classes mein har student ka score. Line graph waqt ke saath rujhan dikhata hai, har din barhti kamai. Histogram taqseem dikhata hai: das mein se zyada scores 80s mein hain. Scatterplot rishta dikhata hai: marks parhai ke ghanton ke saath barhte hain, line marks = 14.3 + 6.14 x hours ke qareeb. Boxplots groups ka muwazna karte hain: dono classes ka median 55 hai, magar Class B ka box aur whiskers kahin chaure hain. Excel ya Google Sheets mein data likh kar select karein, chart insert karein, labels lagayein aur phir parhein ke woh kya batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa data visualization ki qism NAHI: bar chart, scatter plot, hypothesis test, heatmap (MCQ 3)? Do qismein aur un ka istemal bataiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: (c) hypothesis test, jo statistical tareeqa hai, chart nahi. Bar chart qismon ka muwazna karta hai, jaise mukhtalif products ki sales; line graph waqt ke saath rujhan dikhata hai, jaise din bhar ka darja-e-hararat.

items: Chart ki qismein: bar, line, histogram, scatter, boxplot; hypothesis test chart nahi.
